title: Senior Reporter
summary: Demo opening: lead coverage of Ernakulam district, from civic issues to courts, in Malayalam and English.
description:
The role

Demo text. Report and write daily news and longer stories from Kochi.

Responsibilities

  • Find and verify stories
  • File copy, photos and short videos from the field
  • Mentor junior reporters

Requirements

  • Strong Malayalam and English writing
  • A record of published work

Nice to have

  • Court or business reporting experience
